lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the way home, you see a garage sale you've never seen before. On a street you've never seen before.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [reading] "Server Street"? [pause] Since when do we have a Server Street?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And a very old man... who looks at you like he's been waiting.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [creaky, mysterious] Ahh. Finally. [pause] You'll want the laptop.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [mysterious] One dollar. No refunds. [pause] And no questions.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why does it say "do not type"?

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.text: [whispers] Oh, and one more thing... [pause] It's not a game.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You turn around to get your dollar... and the whole garage sale is gone.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [nervous] Cool. Cool cool cool. [pause] Totally normal neighborhood.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At home, the laptop has no apps. No games. Just one black screen... that knows your name.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [calm, robotic] Admin panel loaded. Welcome... you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [whispers] Pancake. Not now. [pause] This is a very spooky moment.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So you do what anyone would do. You type "help."

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Available commands: Fly. Speed. Size. Jail. Teleport. God mode. Noclip. Freeze. [pause] Kick.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [laughs] Admin commands. Like in a game. [pause] So, as a joke... you type: "fly me."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [shocked, then excited] I'm— I'm FLYING! I'm actually— [bonk] OW. Ceiling. There's a ceiling.
